name: Kou
source:
A youkai that appeared in front of Touya.

When Toya saved her life as a child, she betrayed the youkai and jumped into human society in order to repay Toya for his kindness. Since her childhood was short, her body is mature but her heart is pure.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/react-kikou-1]official website[/url]]
